item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's teacher writes one answer on the board: "The wet clothes on the balcony dried faster than the ones in the room."

The teacher asks each student to work backwards and invent a curious, scientific question that this answer could sensibly belong to.

Which row shows a student whose question is a valid scientific question for the given answer?

options.A: student: Arjun; what the student does: copies the textbook question "What is evaporation?" because it sounds scientific; valid for the given answer: no
options.B: student: Sana; what the student does: imagines the balcony is windy and asks "Does moving air make wet clothes dry faster?" which can be tested by hanging clothes in two places; valid for the given answer: yes
options.C: student: Rohan; what the student does: asks "Will the clothes dry?" even though everyone already knows the answer; valid for the given answer: no
options.D: student: Priya; what the student does: asks "Do clothes dry faster because the balcony likes them?" which cannot be tested by any observation; valid for the given answer: no
